features.name: Spontaneous Arcane Spellcasting
features.summary: Cast known Bard spells using Charisma without preparing them, progressing through 6th-level spells.

features.name: Cantrips
features.summary: Know Bard cantrips and cast them at will.

features.name: Bardic Knowledge
features.summary: Add half Bard level, minimum +1, to all Knowledge checks and attempt them untrained.

features.name: Bardic Performance
features.summary: Produce one learned performance at a time, starting it as a standard action and maintaining it as a free action.
features.scaling: 4 + Charisma modifier + 2 rounds per Bard level after 1st

features.name: Countersong
features.summary: Use an audible performance check in place of saves against sonic or language-dependent magical attacks.

features.name: Distraction
features.summary: Use a visual performance check in place of saves against pattern and figment illusions.

features.name: Fascinate
features.summary: Fascinate attentive creatures with an audible and visual performance.
features.scaling: one additional target per 3 levels after 1st

features.name: Inspire Courage +1
features.summary: Grant allies bonuses against fear and charm and on weapon attacks and damage.

features.name: Versatile Performance 1
features.summary: Choose a performance type whose bonus can replace two associated skill bonuses.

features.name: Well-Versed
features.summary: Gain +4 on saves against bardic performance, sonic, and language-dependent effects.

features.name: Inspire Competence +2
features.summary: Grant an ally +2 on checks with one suitable skill.

features.name: Inspire Courage +2
features.summary: Increase the bonuses granted by Inspire Courage to +2.

features.name: Lore Master
features.summary: Take 10 on trained Knowledge checks and take 20 on one Knowledge check each day.

features.name: Spell Exchange
features.summary: At 5th level and every three levels thereafter, exchange one known spell for another legal spell of the same level.

features.name: Suggestion
features.summary: Make a magical suggestion to a creature currently fascinated by your performance.

features.name: Versatile Performance 2
features.summary: Choose a second performance type for skill substitution.

features.name: Move-Action Performance
features.summary: Start a bardic performance as a move action.

features.name: Inspire Competence +3
features.summary: Increase the skill bonus granted by Inspire Competence to +3.

features.name: Dirge of Doom
features.summary: Cause nearby enemies who perceive the performance to become shaken.

features.name: Inspire Greatness
features.summary: Grant bonus Hit Dice, temporary hit points, attack bonuses, and a Fortitude save bonus.
features.scaling: one additional target per 3 levels after 9th

features.name: Jack-of-All-Trades
features.summary: Use skills untrained; later treat all skills as class skills and take 10 on any skill.

features.name: Versatile Performance 3
features.summary: Choose a third performance type for skill substitution.

features.name: Inspire Courage +3
features.summary: Increase the bonuses granted by Inspire Courage to +3.

features.name: Inspire Competence +4
features.summary: Increase the skill bonus granted by Inspire Competence to +4.

features.name: Lore Master
features.summary: Use Lore Master to take 20 twice per day.

features.name: Soothing Performance
features.summary: After four rounds, heal nearby allies and remove fatigued, sickened, and shaken conditions.

features.name: Swift-Action Performance
features.summary: Start a bardic performance as a swift action.

features.name: Frightening Tune
features.summary: Cause nearby enemies who fail a Will save to become frightened.

features.name: Versatile Performance 4
features.summary: Choose a fourth performance type for skill substitution.

features.name: Inspire Competence +5
features.summary: Increase the skill bonus granted by Inspire Competence to +5.

features.name: Inspire Heroics
features.summary: Grant tremendous saving throw and Armor Class bonuses to willing allies.
features.scaling: one additional target per 3 levels after 15th

features.name: Jack-of-All-Trades: Class Skills
features.summary: Treat every skill as a class skill.

features.name: Inspire Courage +4
features.summary: Increase the bonuses granted by Inspire Courage to +4.

features.name: Lore Master
features.summary: Use Lore Master to take 20 three times per day.

features.name: Mass Suggestion
features.summary: Make a magical suggestion to any number of creatures currently fascinated by your performance.

features.name: Versatile Performance 5
features.summary: Choose a fifth performance type for skill substitution.

features.name: Inspire Competence +6
features.summary: Increase the skill bonus granted by Inspire Competence to +6.

features.name: Jack-of-All-Trades: Take 10
features.summary: Take 10 on any skill check, even when normally prohibited.

features.name: Deadly Performance
features.summary: After one full round of performance, potentially kill one nearby enemy who can see and hear you.
features.scaling: DC 10 + half Bard level + Charisma modifier
